harness_rules: Compile/import the exact retained implementation only in root's authorized isolated validation lane; do not reimplement the state machine as the oracle.
Run each native state scenario in a fresh process/module so production statics need no test-only reset API.
Use controlled monotonic-clock and typed Selection/Completion owners only in a clearly labelled source harness; real guest provenance and physical bytes remain independent gates.
Retain complete source, argv, literal requests, results, event order and every failed first attempt. No author tests or imports have run.
